description: This file defines a UserService class for managing user data, including validation, creation, updating, and database interactions, within a server-side application using TypeORM and custom utilities.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: A service class for handling user-related operations such as validation, creation, update, and database interactions.

methods.name: validateUserId
methods.description: Validates if the provided user ID is a valid UUID.

methods.name: readUserById
methods.description: Fetches a user by ID from the database.

methods.name: validateUserName
methods.description: Validates if the user name is valid.

methods.name: validateUserEmail
methods.description: Validates if the user email is valid.

methods.name: readUserByEmail
methods.description: Fetches a user by email from the database.

methods.name: readUserByToken
methods.description: Fetches a user by temporary token.

methods.name: validateUserStatus
methods.description: Validates if the user status is valid.

methods.name: createNewUser
methods.description: Creates a new user record in the database.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Saves user data to the database.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a user with transaction management.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates user data, including password change and session invalidation.
